### Analysis of Dataset Schema and First Row

**Approach:**
I utilized the `get_columns_with_first_row` tool to inspect the structure of the dataset resource `990157`. This tool retrieves the full list of column names and the data values from the first row of the dataset, providing a representative sample of the data types and content.

**Findings:**
The dataset contains 16 columns related to sediment analysis, specifically focusing on radiometric dating (Lead-210 and Cesium-137) and geographic metadata.

**Column Structure and First Row Values:**

| Column Name | First Row Value | Description/Inference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Depth sed** | 0.0025 | Sediment depth (likely in meters). |
| **Depth sed top** | 0.0 | Top boundary of the sediment layer. |
| **Depth sed bot** | 0.005 | Bottom boundary of the sediment layer. |
| **210Pb** | 147.1 | Total Lead-210 activity. |
| **210Pb std dev** | 6.9 | Standard deviation for total 210Pb. |
| **210Pb sup** | 38.9 | Supported Lead-210 activity. |
| **210Pb sup std dev** | 3.1 | Standard deviation for supported 210Pb. |
| **210Pb unsup** | 108.2 | Unsupported (excess) Lead-210 activity. |
| **210Pb unsup std dev** | 7.6 | Standard deviation for unsupported 210Pb. |
| **137Cs** | null | Cesium-137 activity (missing in this row). |
| **137Cs std dev** | null | Standard deviation for 137Cs (missing in this row). |
| **Event** | "LSMo22-1" | Identifier for the sampling event or core. |
| **Latitude** | 21.365278 | Geographic latitude coordinate. |
| **Longitude** | -104.568333 | Geographic longitude coordinate. |
| **Elevation** | 750.0 | Elevation of the sampling site. |
| **Date/Time** | "2022-04-08" | Date of the sample collection or analysis. |

**Results:**
The dataset appears to be a sediment core analysis record. The first row represents a specific depth interval (0.0025m to 0.005m) from a sample collected at "LSMo22-1" on April 8, 2022, located at coordinates 21.365278° N, 104.568333° W with an elevation of 750.0. Notably, the `137Cs` measurements are null for this specific depth interval, while Lead-210 measurements are present with associated standard deviations.
